name: Yildirim Keyword Pool – AI Content Writer === Contributors:
author: yildirimmedyacom

sections.description:
Yildirim Keyword Pool – AI Content Writer is a free, fully functional
WordPress plugin for manual AI-assisted content generation from a
practical Keyword Pool.

Add keywords individually or import them in bulk, provide your business
context through the Brand Profile, configure your preferred content
language and publishing settings, and generate WordPress articles when
you choose.

Key Features

  • Keyword Pool management for organizing content ideas.
  • Manual AI-assisted article generation with no plugin-imposed article
    quota.
  • CSV, TXT and Excel (.xlsx) keyword import.
  • Brand Profile for business-aware content context.
  • Turkish and English content generation.
  • Content language and locale controls.
  • SEO title, meta description and focus keyword generation.
  • Yoast SEO and Rank Math metadata integration when those plugins are
    available.
  • WordPress category and publish-status controls.
  • Activity logs for monitoring generation and publishing events.
  • Uses your own OpenAI API key.

How It Works

  1. Add or import keywords into your Keyword Pool.
  2. Configure your Brand Profile and content preferences.
  3. Select the keyword you want to use.
  4. Click Generate Now.
  5. Review the generated content and its SEO metadata.

The free plugin performs generation manually. It does not automatically
process the Keyword Pool.

PRO Automation

A separately distributed PRO product is available for users who need
additional automation features, including automatic Keyword Pool
processing, RSS source monitoring, sitemap scanning, automated
publishing and scheduling, image automation, advanced internal linking,
and queue-based bulk production.

The PRO implementation is not included in or locked inside this
WordPress.org package. The free plugin remains fully functional for its
advertised manual content-generation features.

AI-generated content can contain inaccurate, incomplete or outdated
information. Review generated content before publishing or relying on
it.

External services

OpenAI

Yildirim Keyword Pool connects to the OpenAI API only after an
administrator enters an OpenAI API key and manually requests content
generation. The selected keyword and configured Brand Profile/content
context are sent to OpenAI to generate the requested article.

Service provider: OpenAI Service: https://openai.com/ Terms:
https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/ Service Terms:
https://openai.com/policies/service-terms/ Privacy:
https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

No Yıldırım Medya licensing, quota, announcement or remote-control
service is required or contacted by this plugin.

Source code

All PHP, JavaScript and CSS shipped with this plugin are human-readable
source files. No minified or compiled JavaScript bundle is distributed
and no build step is required to modify the shipped assets.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Yildirim Keyword Pool – AI Content Writer.
  2. Open Yildirim Keyword Pool > AI & Publishing.
  3. Add your own OpenAI API key.
  4. Complete the Brand Profile if desired.
  5. Import or add keywords to the Keyword Pool.
  6. Click Generate Now on the keyword you want to process.
  7. Review the generated article and SEO information.
sections.faq:
Is there an article quota?

No. The plugin does not impose an article quota on manual Keyword Pool
generation. OpenAI API usage and charges are handled through your own
OpenAI account.

Do I need my own OpenAI API key?

Yes. AI-assisted content generation uses the OpenAI API through the API
key that you configure in your own WordPress installation.

Does it automatically process my Keyword Pool?

No. In the free plugin, each article is generated only when an
administrator clicks Generate Now for a keyword.

Does the plugin send my OpenAI API key to Yıldırım Medya?

No. The key remains in your WordPress installation and is used only for
requests to OpenAI.

Can I import keywords in bulk?

Yes. The Keyword Pool supports CSV, TXT and Excel (.xlsx) imports.

Does it support SEO metadata?

Yes. The plugin can generate SEO titles, meta descriptions and focus
keywords. It also integrates metadata with Yoast SEO and Rank Math when
those plugins are available.

What is available in PRO?

The separately distributed PRO product adds automation-oriented
functionality such as automatic Keyword Pool processing, RSS monitoring,
sitemap scanning, automated publishing and scheduling, image automation,
advanced internal linking, and queue-based bulk production. These
implementations are separate from this WordPress.org plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.11

  • First public WordPress.org release. * Added manual Keyword
    Pool content generation using the user’s own OpenAI API key. * Added
    CSV, TXT and XLSX keyword import. * Added Brand Profile for
    business-aware content context. * Added Turkish and English content
    language controls. * Added SEO title, meta description and focus keyword
    generation. * Added Yoast SEO and Rank Math metadata integration when
    available. * Added WordPress publishing and category controls. * Added
    activity logging. * Refined the responsive WordPress admin interface and
    plugin branding. * Added an optional information link to a separately
    distributed PRO product with additional automation features.
